definitions.explanation: Yielding easily to pressure, not hard or firm. Used for food, textures, and materials.
When describing personality, light, or movements, means gentle and not harsh.
Easily bent or adapted, not rigid.

notes:
{柔|やわ}らかい is an i-adjective meaning soft, tender, gentle, or flexible.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {柔|やわ}らかく
- Noun form: {柔|やわ}らかさ (softness)
- Te-form: {柔|やわ}らかくて

THREE MAIN MEANINGS:
1. Physical softness: {柔|やわ}らかい⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (tender meat)
2. Gentle quality: {柔|やわ}らかい⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧ (soft light)
3. Flexibility: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{柔|やわ}らかい (flexible-minded)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔|やわ}らかい⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: soft skin
- {柔|やわ}らかい⟦{物腰|ものごし}→物腰：noentry⟧: gentle manner
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{柔|やわ}らかい: to be physically flexible

OPPOSITE:
⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧ (hard, stiff, rigid)

KANJI VARIANT:
{軟|やわ}らかい is an alternative spelling with the same meaning.
